description: Read-only status of a Dispersed 3D trip from its 8-character code (like ABCD-2345): the day and clock of the last saved move, the last few moves, finished or not, the end-card gas and water once the trip is over, and the link to watch it. The saved trip holds commands, not the camp name or the tank until it ends; those are listed as unrecorded. Never changes a trip.

code.description: The trip code the game shows: 8 characters, a dash allowed after the fourth.

name: trip_status
title: Where a Dispersed 3D trip is
